name: V ob'jat'jah ejforii
source:
"In the Arms of Euphoria" is a visual novel with elements of a dating simulator.

The events of the game unfold in a boarding school where difficult teenagers study and live, as well as orphaned teenagers. The narration is conducted on behalf of a graduate guy, for whom this academic year will be the last.

At one of the parties at the end of last year, he ends up in the hospital with a drug overdose, and spends the whole summer in rehabilitation. The game begins on September 1, when the hero returns to the boarding school with new strength and hopes.

The project is a "sandbox" where the main character will have to study, work, hang out with friends and meet girls. In the current version, the plot ends around the middle of October, but nothing prevents you from continuing to play further. Attention! There is 18+ content present
